problem_statement: A Security Policy's flags are not preserved through a decode-then-encode round-trip: the three reserved bits of the Security Policy flags byte can be lost, so a decoded policy that had a reserved bit set to 0 re-encodes that bit back to 1, and a zero-initialized Security Policy structure encodes the reserved bits as 0 instead of the specification-mandated default of 1. After decoding flags that contain a cleared reserved bit, the policy must re-encode the same flags unchanged, and a zero-initialized Security Policy (as applications build otOperationalDataset field-by-field) must encode all reserved bits as 1, both standalone and through a Dataset round-trip.
